title: Handy (cjpais) — Tauri 2 dictation app, production reference for Rust-side audio
notes: Verified live 2026-11-09 (GitHub API + raw Cargo.toml + README + crates.io). MIT, 38,196 stars, pushed 2026-11-07. Relevance: Jerry SPEC-VOICE reference implementation for capture/playback/model-bootstrap patterns.

sections.heading: Production pattern
sections.body: cpal Rust-side capture 16kHz mono f32 -> Silero VAD -> transcribe-cpp GGUF STT -> clipboard/paste. rodio+symphonia playback Rust-side. hf-hub model downloads. global-shortcut + rdev hotkeys. Zero webview audio.

sections.heading: WebKitGTK battle scars
sections.body: Three renderer workarounds (per-version WEBKIT_DMABUF_RENDERER etc.); SIGUSR1 must not be listened for (WebKitGTK uses it for JS GC — phantom recordings). Confirms avoiding webview media entirely.
